description: This file defines Kubernetes RBAC (Role-Based Access Control) API types for version v1, including roles, role bindings, cluster roles, and their associated metadata, rules, subjects, and references.

classes.name: PolicyRule
classes.description: Represents a set of permissions including verbs, API groups, resources, resource names, and non-resource URLs.

classes.name: Subject
classes.description: References a user, group, or service account to which a role applies.

classes.name: RoleRef
classes.description: Points to a specific role or cluster role being referenced.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: A namespaced grouping of PolicyRules that can be assigned via RoleBinding.

classes.name: RoleBinding
classes.description: Associates subjects with a role within a namespace.

classes.name: ClusterRole
classes.description: A cluster-wide grouping of PolicyRules, can be aggregated from other roles.

classes.name: AggregationRule
classes.description: Defines how to aggregate multiple ClusterRoles into a single ClusterRole.

classes.name: ClusterRoleBinding
classes.description: Associates subjects with a ClusterRole at the cluster level.
